name: Camping Lermoos
beschreibung: The Lermoos campsite is located at around 1,004 metres above sea level at the foot of the Zugspitze in the district of Reutte in Tirol. The surroundings are characterized by the Zugspitzarena ski area as well as numerous hiking and mountain biking trails that are accessible directly from the site. The site itself offers pitches for motorhomes and caravans as well as sanitary facilities with washrooms and supply and disposal facilities. Amenities include a small grocery store and a restaurant on the grounds. Guests can expect a quiet atmosphere with unobstructed views of the mountain range of the Wetterstein. In the winter season, visitors benefit from the proximity to the ski slopes and cross-country ski trails in Lermoos and Ehrwald. The location is suitable both for seasonal camping and for travelers passing through the Außerfern. The operation focuses on functional accommodation without additional tourist amenities.
